nodes.label: Architecture Notes
nodes.rationale: On-demand DynamoDB billing and 15-minute minimum polling chosen for free-tier cost control

nodes.label: RuntimeContextInterceptor
nodes.rationale: Resolves Alexa access token to userId via Turso and captures runtime context (locale, notification permission, API endpoint/token) into DynamoDB

nodes.label: Lambda Configuration
nodes.rationale: Default encryption key embedded as HOSTED_FALLBACK_APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY for Alexa-hosted skills; production must override with secure KMS or custom key

nodes.label: Poller Job
nodes.rationale: EventBridge 15-minute trigger scans due users via nextDueAt; sends notifications only when message ID diff detects new mail

nodes.label: Crypto Service
nodes.rationale: Three-tier encryption strategy: KMS envelope (preferred) → AES-GCM with APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY → base64 plaintext fallback

nodes.label: Runtime Secrets
nodes.rationale: Multi-tier secret loading with env vars → runtime-secrets.txt → DynamoDB discovery fallback, cached 5 minutes to reduce DynamoDB reads

nodes.label: POP Connector
nodes.rationale: POP protocol lacks persistent unread state; unread approximation uses seenUids history from prior sync snapshots

nodes.label: syncAccount
nodes.rationale: Performs incremental sync by comparing previous mailbox state with connector output to detect new messages; stores cache in DynamoDB and account metadata in Turso

nodes.label: resolveAccessToken
nodes.rationale: Lazy refresh pattern: only refreshes OAuth tokens when about to expire, minimizing token churn

nodes.label: repository.js
nodes.rationale: Dual storage abstraction: DynamoDB for Lambda-only message cache and runtime context; Turso for shared entities accessed by both Lambda and Web

nodes.label: RuntimeContextInterceptor
nodes.rationale: Every request resolves Alexa access token to userId via Turso hashed token lookup and captures runtime Alexa context (apiEndpoint, notificationPermission) into DynamoDB

nodes.label: config.js
nodes.rationale: Centralized configuration with environment variable defaults; includes a hosted fallback encryption key for Alexa-hosted skills

nodes.label: popConnector.js
nodes.rationale: POP3 does not track read state server-side; unread count is approximated by comparing UIDL history against previously seen UIDs stored in snapshot

nodes.label: Runtime Secrets Loader
nodes.rationale: Loads secrets with priority: env vars → runtime-secrets.txt file → DynamoDB item. Results are in-memory cached for 5 minutes.

nodes.label: Crypto Service
nodes.rationale: Encryption tiers: 1) KMS envelope when KMS_KEY_ID is set; 2) AES-GCM when APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY is set; 3) Base64 plaintext fallback.

nodes.label: Mail Service
nodes.rationale: Dispatches to connectors via syncService, reads cached mailbox state from repository.

nodes.label: Sync Service
nodes.rationale: Incremental sync + cache refresh logic. Detects new messages by comparing IDs with previous state.

nodes.label: OAuth Refresh Service
nodes.rationale: Refreshes Gmail/Outlook tokens before use, encrypts updated credentials back to Turso via repository.

nodes.label: Account Service
nodes.rationale: Runtime user context capture (locale, notification permission, API endpoint) into DynamoDB profile.

nodes.label: Repository
nodes.rationale: Split storage: DynamoDB for Alexa profile and mailbox message cache; Turso for linked accounts, OAuth tokens, polling prefs, user records.

nodes.label: Manual Account Route
nodes.rationale: Accepts IMAP/POP credentials including optional SMTP fields and passes them to accounts module for encrypted storage.

nodes.label: isAllowedRedirectUri
nodes.rationale: Restricts OAuth redirect URIs to Amazon domains or localhost to prevent open redirect vulnerabilities during Alexa account linking.

nodes.label: Alexa OAuth Token Route
nodes.rationale: Implements Alexa OAuth 2.0 token endpoint supporting authorization_code and refresh_token grants, validating client credentials via Basic Auth header or POST parameters.

nodes.label: DashboardPage
nodes.rationale: Server component that renders account management UI and interprets flash notices from API redirects via searchParams, avoiding client-side state. Polling UI mentions 15-minute minimum to keep AWS costs in free-tier-friendly range.

nodes.label: authenticateWithPassword
nodes.rationale: Create-on-first-login pattern auto-provisions users. Legacy profiles without passwordHash are auto-migrated to scrypt-v1 on next login.

nodes.label: encryptJson
nodes.rationale: Web runtime uses AES-GCM when APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY is set, falls back to base64 plaintext. No KMS envelope support unlike Lambda backend.

nodes.label: setPollingInterval
nodes.rationale: Normalizes input to allowed tiers: 15/30/60 minutes. Values between tiers round up to next tier.

nodes.label: deleteAccount
nodes.rationale: Soft-delete pattern sets status=DISCONNECTED. Auto-reassigns activeAccountId to remaining active account or null.

nodes.label: config
nodes.rationale: Web runtime configuration with env var defaults. No AWS SDK dependency — runs on Vercel.
